---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing any page of the Ghar Stays apartment booking website.
---

1. The brand name is **Ghar Stays** and the tagline is "Your home in Lahore." Write in a warm, polite, confident tone, like a good hotel host. Keep sentences short.
2. Use only these colours: deep green #1F3D36 for the header, footer and headings; sand #F4EDE2 for the page background; terracotta #C8643B for buttons and highlights; charcoal #222222 for body text; white #FFFFFF for cards.
3. Use Google Fonts: "Playfair Display" for headings and "Inter" for all other text. Load them with a <link> tag in the <head>.
4. Every page must have: a sticky header with the logo text "Ghar Stays" and links to Home, Apartments, About and Contact; a footer with "© 2026 Ghar Stays · Lahore", a WhatsApp number and an email.
5. Show apartments as cards in a responsive grid. Each card has an emoji, the apartment name, the area (Gulberg, DHA or Johar Town), bedrooms, guests and the nightly price.
6. Write prices as "Rs 12,500 / night", with "Rs", a space and comma separators. Never use "PKR" or "$".
7. Write dates as "12 Dec 2026". Write phone numbers as "0300-1234567".
8. Every booking or contact form must check that the phone number has exactly 11 digits and starts with 03, and show a friendly red error message if not. On success, show a green "Thank you, we'll WhatsApp you within an hour" message.
9. Buttons are terracotta with white text, rounded corners (8px), and darken slightly on hover.
10. The site must work well on a phone first: single column under 700px wide.
11. Keep all CSS and JavaScript inside the same HTML file. Use no frameworks or build tools.
12. Never use stock photo links, "Lorem ipsum" or made-up guest reviews. Use emojis instead of images, and real-sounding but clearly sample content.
